[[image:Marcellus.png|thumb|right|250px|Marcellus]] '''Marcellus''' (Japanese: '''ハチロウ''' ''Hachiro'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP215|Octillery the Outcast]]''. He lives in [[Scarlet City]] on [[Red Rock Isle]]. Shortly before the [[Whirl Cup]] began, Marcellus approached {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}}, requesting a {{pkmn|battle}}. He wanted his {{p|Remoraid}} to evolve into an {{p|Octillery}} so he could have a strong Pokémon for the competition. {{an|Misty}} accepted the challenge and pitted her {{TP|Misty|Corsola}} against Marcellus's Remoraid. She ended up losing, and Marcellus's Remoraid evolved at the end of the battle. The next day, after the preliminary qualifying rounds, Ash and the others noticed Marcellus appeared to be sad. He revealed that he lost the preliminaries and was now out of the competition and invited the group over to his house for dinner. That night, he explained the reason why he lost: his tank full of Remoraid had treated his newly evolved Octillery so differently and so poorly, neither had been able to concentrate on their preliminary battles and had ended up losing because of it. {{TRT}} arrived and stole all of the Remoraid with their vacuum truck. However, Octillery left an ink trail, allowing Marcellus and the others to track the trio down at a port, where they rescued the Remoraid. After saving Octillery from falling, all of the other Remoraid evolved into Octillery themselves and subsequently inducted Octillery back into their group, pleasing Marcellus. Marcellus was last seen watching the Whirl Cup's stadium empty out its water with Ash, Misty, Brock, and the many trainers who'd made it to the main tournament. ==Pokémon== {{MissingInfo|2|enva|java}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Marcellus |pkmn=Octillery (multiple) |stage1=Remoraid |type1=Water |img=Marcellus Remoraid.png |cap=Marcellus's Remoraid |img2=Marcellus Octillery.png |cap2=Marcellus's Octillery |epnum=EP215 |epname=Octillery the Outcast |vajp=Rikako Aikawa |vaen= |desc=Marcellus has multiple {{p|Octillery}} that all evolved from {{p|Remoraid}} he collected from different seas. They all reside in a giant aquarium tank inside Marcellus's [[Scarlet City]] mansion. The first one that evolved initially appeared as a Remoraid in a battle against {{an|Misty}}, with Marcellus hoping it would evolve in time for the [[Whirl Cup]]. Misty sent out her {{TP|Misty|Corsola}} to battle it, but Remoraid defeated it, evolving into Octillery as a result. The next day, Marcellus approached {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}}, where he revealed that his other unevolved Remoraid were acting strange towards his new Octillery, using their Water Gun to push it away. Later that night, {{TRT}} stole the Remoraid and escaped just when Marcellus noticed them, but his Octillery went after them and left a trail. Octillery took on Team Rocket, headbutting them around until it smashed through the tank containing the stolen Remoraid, freeing them. The Remoraid freed Octillery from Team Rocket's crane and softened its landing with their Water Guns. Afterwards, Octillery sent Team Rocket blasting off with an Octazooka attack. The experience and teamwork prompted the remaining Remoraid to evolve at the same time, and Marcellus's first Octillery and the newly evolved ones became friends again. Octillery's only known move is {{m|Water Gun}}; one of them also knows {{m|Surf}} and {{m|Octazooka}}.}} ==Pokémon competitions== Marcellus has competed in the following {{cat|Pokémon competitions}}: * [[Whirl Cup]] - Preliminaries (''[[EP215|Octillery the Outcast]]'') ==Trivia== * Marcellus's Japanese name and the fact he owns an {{p|Octillery}} is a reference to the famous Japanese boxer Taku Hachirou, with "tako" being the Japanese word for octopus. ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{water color}}|bordercolor={{water color light}} |ja=佐藤ゆうこ ''Yūko Satō'' |en=[[Amy Birnbaum]] |it=Federica Valenti |pt_br=Figueira Jr. |es_la=Enzo Fortuny |es_eu=Marisa Marco |pl=Renata Berger|nl=Marjolein Algera}}
